Remark. Homogeneity of the derivation chain under the calibration discipline

Homogeneity of the chain

Induction along the 19-link derivation chain. At each step:

  • Base. The categorical action \mathfrak{S} = \mathrm{tr}(\Phi) is a \mathbb{Q}(q)-valued endomorphism trace (categorical-action) — dimensionless, living in H^1.
  • Frobenius pairing. Preserves \mathbb{Q}(q)-rationality (frobenius-pairing); identifies A \cong A^\vee in H^0 \oplus H^1.
  • Mass identity. Introduces the Frobenius norm \|\cdot\| on A (mass-identity) — the norm is itself a \mathbb{Q}(q)-valued Markov-trace expression in H^0, not an Archimedean absolute value. The single H^0 insertion is multiplied by m_e at the reporting step.
  • Hecke descent. \Phi_{\mathrm{mass}}(\beta) \in H_n(q) is a \mathbb{Q}(q)-element of the Hecke algebra (hecke-mass-element).
  • Markov trace. \mathrm{tr}_M : H_n(q) \to \mathbb{Q}(q) (jones-markov-trace).
  • Tower. The mass-tower formula (mass-endomorphism-tower) is built from Markov-trace expressions, \Phi_q-tower terms, and rational coefficients in z — all in \mathbb{Q}(q).
  • Meson sector. The orthogonal \mathrm{Vol}(\mathrm{Hopf}) = 0 class supplies the single meson scale m_\pi, independent of (m_e, q_0) (the Hopf-link complement has zero hyperbolic volume). \mathfrak{Q}_\beta, the CAL-2 proxy, is itself reproduced from m_e and the already-pinned q_0 via the substrate identity 
      \mathfrak{Q}_\beta \;=\; m_e\,\frac{\lvert q_0^2 - 2q_0 - 1\rvert\,(q_0+1)}{2\,q_0^{3}}
  \;\approx\; 0.784\ \text{MeV}\quad(0.17\%\text{ vs CODATA}),
    the bar-odd (\sinh) partner of the bar-even (\cosh) meson scale m_\pi: the descent obstruction class (motivic perpetual obstruction theorem) is normalised by the already-fixed scales, not by a fourth input.

The dimensional factors m_e and m_\pi enter only at the final reporting step (tower-binding-energy), multiplying the dimensionless tower expression to give a value in energy units. The composite functional is therefore \mathfrak{m}(X) = m_e^a m_\pi^c \cdot Q_X(q_0) with Q_X \in \mathbb{Q}(q_0) and a, c \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}.

The discipline is a structural assumption, not a derived result — its content is the class field mass_factorisation of qou:QOU.Observations.ThreeCalibrationDiscipline. What the walk above shows is that the assumption is consistent with the chain as far as the chain is realised. Remaining open conjectures along the chain (mass-endomorphism, phi-q-tower-jsj-bridge) do not affect the dimensional-discipline statement: every step that is realised respects m_e^a m_\pi^c \cdot \mathbb{Q}(q_0) homogeneity, and any future closure of the chain inherits this.
